schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS EVENT_DETAILS (ORG_ID CHAR(32) NOT NULL, CONFIG_KEY CHAR(32) NOT NULL, COMPONENT_NAME VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, REQUEST_ID CHAR(32) NOT NULL, UPDATE_DATE INT NOT NULL, UPDATE_TIME INT NOT NULL, CLIENT CHAR(16) NOT NULL, STATUS INT NOT NULL, EVENT_DATA VARCHAR(1024), MESSAGE VARCHAR(512), INSERTED_TIME TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, INDEX STATE_INDEX (UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_TIME, ORG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, COMPONENT_NAME, STATUS, CLIENT))
